title: 🧪 [Add initialization error catching tests for EosMcpServer]
body:
🎯 **What:** Added missing tests to verify that the try...catch block around knowledgeOntology.registrarNodo and crearEnlace in EosMcpServer constructor correctly handles errors and proceeds without crashing.
📊 **Coverage:** Covered the error throwing scenario by passing a mock knowledgeOntology that throws on node registration and link creation. Also added a happy path test that verifies the registrar methods are called with the correct parameters.
✨ **Result:** Test suite is now more robust by explicitly enforcing the initialization error catching behavior.
